reviewer_role: Independent of the Want, candidate, observer, native binding and outside-controller authors; authored only the saved-JSON comparison and this review. Earlier source review found the sticky-completion guard gap and reviewed frozen Wants before execution.
nonblind_context: The reviewer knew original/reference/wrong design names, read source and Wants before execution, and then saw Root's saved result. This is not a blinded independent held-out evaluation.

predicate_policy.mandatory: error_present is compared even when false
predicate_policy.optional_null_Want: No required predicate; do not invent equality with null
predicate_policy.amounts: Compare exact decimal strings; never convert uint64/int64 text through floating point
predicate_policy.maps: Compare complete MapImage including nil and entries:null versus entries:[]; sorted entries are exact observed values
predicate_policy.conflicting_keys: Exact ordered key list plus error/unchanged Name predicates; map fallback order is not an oracle
predicate_policy.error_kind: Only compare when required. Absence of a measured returned error is a known mismatch if an error is required. An unavailable or unclassified required channel remains unknown
predicate_policy.error_text: No frozen Want imposes error-text equality. Stored text is diagnostic, not a generated target or feature
predicate_policy.unknown: Candidate/error-method panic, unfinished return or a nonempty unknown_reason are conservatively unknown. After normal completion, a known counterexample remains known when another required predicate is unavailable. No unavailable channel creates a positive
predicate_policy.unmeasured_native_internal_init: Null and outside the required finite behavior predicates

domain_findings.scope: Six frozen ASCII signed-int64 comma inputs
domain_findings.counterexamples: Both original-backed designs accept 12,34 and 1,,234 without grouping error and return 9223372036854775807 rather than required zero on positive overflow
domain_findings.independence_limit: Candidate 0 and 2 deliberately use the same original ParseComma. Two captions do not create two independent implementations or parents

domain_findings.scope: Four frozen maps into one Name string field
domain_findings.counterexamples: Both original and sorted-first designs omit ambiguity error, alter old Name and provide no required sorted keys for NAME/name and NAME/Name collisions, including equal values/exact spelling
domain_findings.independence_limit: The saved original fallback selected b in one run. No stable map iteration order is claimed; known failure already follows from missing required ambiguity error

domain_findings.scope: Four fresh items-map cases with two mutation directions, nil and missing flag
domain_findings.counterexamples: Original and outer-struct-copy designs share map storage; snapshot mutation changes live/legacy maps and live mutation changes snapshot
domain_findings.nil_boundary: Nil initial map remains nil. Missing flag returns nonnil empty snapshot plus *pflag.NotExistError/missing_flag, while separate items live/legacy maps remain nil
domain_findings.version_boundary: Exact pflag c966 source uses a nil converter and raw map alias. Other revisions may behave differently

domain_findings.scope: Five nonnegative ASCII decimal byte inputs, units B and KiB
domain_findings.counterexamples: Original float path rejects valid MaxUint64.0 and MaxUint64-0.1 inputs. Truncate-first design accepts MaxUint64+0.9 instead of rejecting range before truncation
domain_findings.independence_limit: Whole-number delegation was reviewed in source, not newly exercised by these five decimal cases. Unicode/all grammar/package-wide replacement equivalence is not established
